critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: 6209 lines — still above the 6k marker from iter-19/20. Sisterhood (5642-5724), Comeback (5727-5747), Review feature (5750-5807), and Waitlist speed (5597-5639) can be moved to routers/services modules.

_sis_link does an upsert find_one_and_update returning return_document=True without specifying ReturnDocument.AFTER — motor defaults to BEFORE, which means on first-insert the method may return None. The `return_document=True` here equals `pymongo.ReturnDocument.AFTER` in the current motor version (truthy), so it works, but is implementation-dependent. Prefer `return_document=ReturnDocument.AFTER` for clarity (same note applies to admin_hide_quote nearby).

feature_consent (server.py:5789): photo_url validation regex only accepts '/api/media/file/UUID'. If any legitimate uploader produces a path with underscores or extensions this will reject it; current /api/stories/photo always returns that shape, so OK, but worth asserting shape in a unit test.
_add_sis (server.py:5650) splices a 'See all my badges in one place' link by locating a hard-coded style fragment `
admin_comebacks (server.py:5738) does one find_one per distinct program_id (N queries). For 100+ programs this becomes slow; a $lookup aggregation would be constant-round.
program_signup (server.py:3265) uses find_one_and_update to atomically mark noshow comeback_at, which is correctly idempotent — nice.

admin_waitlist_speed computes offer_expires from stored field, not programs.offer_hours — so if a program's offer_hours changes, historical offers keep their stored expiry (correct). Tip threshold uses >=5 claims; a program with 4 ultra-fast claims won't get the tip (expected per spec).
